site.tagline: Machine learning research, technical writing, and academic portfolio experiments across static site generators.
site.about: Welcome to my digital corner. I work across mechanistic interpretability, computer vision, and information retrieval, with recent work spanning academic research, applied ML engineering, and startup systems.
site.researchSummary: I am fascinated by mechanistic interpretability, multimodal systems, and practical information retrieval. My current goal is to make my personal website a side-by-side comparison of the academic portfolio patterns each framework encourages.

publication.title: Differential Evolution Algorithm Based Hyper-Parameter Selection of Convolutional Neural Networks for Speech Command Recognition
publication.summary: An evolutionary search approach for CNN hyper-parameters in speech command recognition.
publication.venue: Evolutionary Computation Theory and Applications (IJCCI / ECTA)
publication.authors: Aritra Bandyopadhyay, Anuvab Sen, Sandipan Dhar, Nanda Dulal Jana, Arjun Ghosh, Zahra Sarayloo
publication.abstract: This paper studies speech command recognition and proposes a Differential Evolution based search strategy for CNN hyper-parameters. The goal is to reduce manual tuning cost while improving classification quality on the Google Speech Commands dataset.

blog.title: Come back later
blog.summary: A placeholder notebook-style post for future language model notes.
blog.bodyIntro: This is the one post I kept while reshaping the site: a small placeholder that still demonstrates the kinds of media-rich technical notes I want the final site to support.
blog.bodyOutro: The point of this article in the framework comparison is less the prose and more the route shape: each framework needs to support a nested blog post, basic media embeds, code, and a clean reading layout under a subpath.
